data.title: A voice in the common room
data.goal: A voice in the common room

memoryNodes.cue: One option has the lowest popularity in this group.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 一个选项在这个小组里最不受欢迎。

memoryNodes.cue: Lin describes what helped and what still needs changing.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 林讲述帮助过她的事，以及仍需改变的地方。

memoryNodes.cue: The next plan includes adults returning to study.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 下一份计划包括让成人回到学习中。

data.situation:
At the end of term, the course team invited students to the common room. A small survey chart stood beside the tea tray. In this group, the early-morning physics class was the least popular option, but the chart did not explain why. Lin had an oral presentation to give about her own course. She put her note cards beside the tray and waited for the room to settle. Lin: At first I felt like a misfit. Everyone seemed to know how the university worked. The tutor's questions helped me find a place in the group.
Lecturer: We want to nurture students' interests, including those who have returned after time away. What should we change next term?
Lin: The first email could be shorter. We can learn from the past mistakes recorded on this sheet, instead of sending the same confusing instructions again. Notes from the course meeting
The team will review the first email and the library guide. The aim is to improve overall education quality, not merely to add more tasks. We also want to promote lifelong learning by making it possible for adults to return at different stages of their lives. Before the next registration opens, the team will shorten the email and ask returning students to try the revised guide. To sum up, Lin said, the course had given her one question she could investigate and people she could ask for help. It had not made every page easy. She still carried the tutor's last note in her notebook. When the meeting ended, she returned her cup to the tray and walked past the service counter. The next term's registration letters were already waiting there.

readingBlocks.en: At the end of term, the course team invited students to the common room. A small survey chart stood beside the tea tray. In this group, the early-morning physics class was the least popular option, but the chart did not explain why. Lin had an oral presentation to give about her own course. She put her note cards beside the tray and waited for the room to settle.
readingBlocks.zh: 学期末，课程团队邀请学生来到公共休息室。茶盘旁放着一张小调查图。在这个小组里，清早的物理课是最不受欢迎的选项，可图上并没有解释原因。林要就自己的课程作口头报告。她把提示卡放在茶盘旁，等待房间安静下来。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: At first I felt like a misfit. Everyone seemed to know how the university worked. The tutor's questions helped me find a place in the group.
Lecturer: We want to nurture students' interests, including those who have returned after time away. What should we change next term?
Lin: The first email could be shorter. We can learn from the past mistakes recorded on this sheet, instead of sending the same confusing instructions again.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：起初我觉得自己格格不入。每个人似乎都知道大学怎样运作。导师的问题帮助我在小组里找到了自己的位置。
讲师：我们希望培养学生的兴趣，也包括离开学习一段时间后回来的人。下学期我们该改什么？
林：第一封邮件可以短一点。我们可以从这张表记录的过去错误里吸取教训，不要再发同样令人困惑的指令。

readingBlocks.en:
Notes from the course meeting
The team will review the first email and the library guide. The aim is to improve overall education quality, not merely to add more tasks. We also want to promote lifelong learning by making it possible for adults to return at different stages of their lives. Before the next registration opens, the team will shorten the email and ask returning students to try the revised guide.
readingBlocks.zh:
课程会议记录
团队将检查第一封邮件和图书馆指南。目标是提高整体教学质量，而不只是增加任务。我们也希望让成人在人生不同阶段能够回到学习中，推动终身学习。下次注册开始前，团队会缩短邮件，请重返学习的学生试读修改后的指南。
readingBlocks.title: The meeting notes

readingBlocks.en: To sum up, Lin said, the course had given her one question she could investigate and people she could ask for help. It had not made every page easy. She still carried the tutor's last note in her notebook. When the meeting ended, she returned her cup to the tray and walked past the service counter. The next term's registration letters were already waiting there.
readingBlocks.zh: “总的来说，”林说，“这门课给了我一个能够调查的问题，也让我遇到了可以求助的人。”它没有让每一页都变得容易。林的笔记本里仍夹着导师最后那张便条。会面结束后，她把杯子放回茶盘，走过服务台。下学期的注册信，已经在那里等着了。

glossary.note: least + 形容词表示最低程度；the least popular option为一组选项中最不受欢迎的选项。
glossary.example: The early-morning class was the least popular option in this group.
glossary.exampleZh: 清早的课是这个小组里最不受欢迎的选项。

glossary.note: 形容用言语而不是文字完成；不是口腔医学用法。
glossary.example: Lin gives an oral presentation about the course.

glossary.zh: 觉得或被认为与群体不合的人
glossary.note: 可数名词，feel like a misfit表示觉得自己在某个群体中格格不入。
glossary.example: At first, Lin felt like a misfit in the class.
glossary.exampleZh: 起初，林觉得在课堂里格格不入。

externalEvidence.definition: someone unable to adapt to their circumstances

glossary.note: 动词nurture + 兴趣、才能等，在支持中发展；本例不是喂养。
glossary.example: The lecturers want to nurture students’ interests.
glossary.exampleZh: 讲师希望培养学生的兴趣。

glossary.zh: 从过往错误中吸取教训
glossary.note: the在本句指表上特定的那些错误；泛指通常用learn from past mistakes。
glossary.example: We can learn from the past mistakes recorded on this sheet.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们可以从这张表记录的过去错误里吸取教训。

glossary.note: 表示教育质量的组合表达；也可说the overall quality of education。
glossary.example: The team aims to improve overall education quality.
glossary.exampleZh: 团队的目标是提高整体教学质量。

glossary.zh: 推动人们终身持续学习
glossary.note: promote + 学习活动或目标；lifelong表示贯穿一生，不是仅一学期。
glossary.example: The course team wants to promote lifelong learning.
glossary.exampleZh: 课程团队希望推动终身学习。

glossary.note: 用于归纳前面的主要意思，适合发言或文章结尾；不是另起无关论点。
glossary.example: To sum up, the course gave Lin a question to investigate.
glossary.exampleZh: 总的来说，课程给了林一个能调查的问题。

retrievalPrompts.function: A voice in the common room
retrievalPrompts.cue: State what the small survey shows and explain how Lin will report on her course.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说出小调查显示什么，并说明林会如何介绍自己的课程。
acceptableAnswers: The early-morning class was the least popular option in this group. Lin will give an oral presentation.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.function: A voice in the common room
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain how Lin felt at the beginning and what the teachers want to support.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明林最初的感受，以及教师想支持什么。
acceptableAnswers: Lin felt like a misfit at first. The lecturers want to nurture students’ interests.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.function: A voice in the common room
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the aims of the next course plan.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明下一份课程计划的目标。
acceptableAnswers: The team aims to improve overall education quality and promote lifelong learning. They can learn from the past mistakes recorded on the sheet.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: You are ending a short talk about returning to a hobby group. Give a concise summary of what helped you.

checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
